caption:
Google core update checklist: 4 things Black-owned businesses should check while Google reshuffles search before Black Friday.

Google started rolling out its November 2026 core update on November 10, 2026. A core update is a broad change to how Google ranks pages, and this one applies globally and in all languages. Google says it may take up to two weeks, which puts the latest finish on November 24, three days before Black Friday on November 27.

Here's what to check this week:
1. Your Google Business Profile hours, phone number and website link are right for the holidays.
2. Each service or product has its own clear page on your website.
3. Your city and neighborhood are written out in plain words on your site.
4. Your site loads fast on a phone and the next step is obvious.

If your traffic dips, don't rush to rebuild. Google suggests waiting at least a week after the rollout ends before comparing results, so note what changes and when.
